mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have temperatures sitting at 78 degrees with overcast skies by Harriet Park. The moon phase is a waxing crescent, and we are looking at an overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain expected through the night.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking reliable volunteers to help with their essential services. They ask for a commitment of at least two times per month. Please note that some roles involve standing or lifting up to 20 pounds, and all volunteers must maintain strict confidentiality regarding the seniors they assist.

There is plenty to do! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or take the kids to Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena.

In our weekly police report, we want to highlight an incident from August 6th. An officer observed a vehicle driving erratically and speeding, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I, fourth offence.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Turtle flavor of the day at Culver's. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth.
